notes: Supersedes selected v002 (valid 14.7, test 30.0), whose lambda_phy was 0.0 so the physics residual was never computed - the case was physics-informed in name only. This v003 configuration has an ACTIVE physics term (lambda_phy = 1.2346683760352606e-07; final-20% physics-activity ratio 0.02052459096457961; gradient audit PASS) and its final computation reproduced BITWISE (23/23 scalars, 10/10 artifacts). Validation median 19.8 across 15 seeds (mean 17.29, min 8.5, max 23.1). Test horizon 7.3 is far below validation; the drop is reported as found and did NOT trigger retuning. A paired validation-only ablation for this one configuration favours the active arm (median 19.8 vs 14.8, median paired difference +2.1, active better on 11 of 15 seeds, zero-weight better on 4); no active-versus-zero comparison exists on the test split. v002 and v003 differ in architecture, hyperparameters, seed and selection workflow, so their test values do not isolate the effect of physics.
